text: Task Deck 是面向 DSH Web/Desktop 的个人会话任务看板，在侧边栏汇总实时会话并提供任务详情与线程面板。它把会话状态和个人标注组合成可搜索、可筛选的任务视图，支持继续会话、创建分支或交接，并记录下一步行动、清单和优先级；统计页展示工作时间、回合和 token 用量。统计通过本机只读路由计算，不要求 API 密钥。

Task Deck adds a DSH Web/Desktop sidebar for organizing live sessions as searchable tasks. Track status, next actions, checklists, and priority; continue a session or create a branch or handoff. Its stats page reports work time, turns, and token usage through a local read-only route.
我想在侧边栏集中查看多个 DSH 会话的状态和待办。
能不能从一个会话快速开分支或把任务交给后续处理？
I want a searchable dashboard to organize DSH conversations and their next actions.
Task Deck 的功能「会话任务看板」：在侧边栏把 DSH 会话整理为任务，可按状态浏览并搜索。进入侧边栏的 Task Deck 面板即可查看。
Task Deck 的功能「继续与分支交接」：可打开现有会话，或从会话创建子分支；交接模式会把新分支标为等待，并保存任务说明。

@local/dsh-task-deck README · Features：- **Sidebar entry** — Task Deck in `sidebar.panellist`, with a badge for Blocked + Review.
- **Live Dashboard** — real DSH conversations grouped by state, with search and status filters.
- **Task Detail** — real session title / ID / workspace, running state, fork lineage, an editable personal Next Action, personal checklist, related conversations, review gate.
- **Task Thread** — a right-sidebar tab and conversation-header launcher bound to the current `sessionId`.
- **Continue / Fork / Handoff** — open the current conversation, create a real child session with `sessions.fork()`, or fork-and-mark-waiting for a parallel workflow.
- **Personal annotation layer** — status overrides, Next Action, checks, priority, branch label, and alias are yours; they never rewrite the conversation.
- **Idle auto-complete** — conversations idle from 1 hour to 30 days (default 14 days) move to Done automatically. Manual Waiting keeps one open; choose Auto to return to the rule.
- **Stats page** — per-conversation work time, wall-clock span, turns and token usage (input / cache read / cache write / output). A hand-drawn SVG chart set (no chart library, no external

@local/dsh-task-deck README · From a release tarball：Download `dsh-task-deck-1.5.0.tgz` from the latest Release, then ask your DSH agent to run:

```text
plugin_manager install_bundle /absolute/path/to/dsh-task-deck-1.5.0.tgz
```

Refresh the DSH Web GUI. The entry appears near the bottom of the sidebar, beside Plugins and Schedules.

@local/dsh-task-deck README · From a source checkout：```bash
git clone https://github.com/astephengoo-arch/dsh-task-deck.git
```

Then:

```text
plugin_manager install_bundle /absolute/path/to/dsh-task-deck
```

@local/dsh-task-deck README · How the data works：| Layer | Source |
|---|---|
| Session identity, title, workspace, running/idle, recent activity, fork parent | `ctx.sessions.list` |
| Status override, Next Action, checklist, priority, branch label, alias | Personal annotations in `localStorage` (`dsh.taskDeck.annotations.v1`) |
| Continue | `ctx.uiWorkspace.openSession(sessionId)` |
| Fork / Handoff | `ctx.sessions.fork({ sessionId, increaseTitle: true })` |

@local/dsh-task-deck README · How the data works：Task Deck never copies transcripts. `Active` is a live runtime fact: a session is Active while its agent is running, and returns to Waiting (or your manual Blocked / Review / Done) when it stops.

`Done` can be manual or automatic. Auto-done is derived from the last activity timestamp: a non-running session with no manual status becomes Done after the configured idle window. Set Waiting manually to keep it open, or choose Auto in the status field to return to the automatic rule.

@local/dsh-task-deck README · Requirements：- DSH `>= 0.2.1-rc.5`
- Web/Desktop Client with `sidebarRightTabs` and `sidebarRight`

@local/dsh-task-deck README · Development：The plugin is plain JavaScript and has no build step.

```bash
node --check client.js
node --check index.js
```

@local/dsh-task-deck README · Privacy：- Reads DSH session metadata (title, id, workspace, running state, fork relation). - Stores only personal annotations in browser `localStorage`. - No transcript upload, no analytics, no external network calls.
